svg.title: Color Panels for a Large Wall II
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and interpretive colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Gallery installation reference: two horizontal rows of nine colored panels. Relative gaps and reported overall installation dimensions approximate. Colors manually counted; precise pigments interpretive. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of brown, orange, red; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-color-panels-for-a-large-wall-11-2018/lightbox/works/color-panels-for-a-large-wall-ii-1978-43938; record matthewmarks-color-panels-for-a-large-wall-ii-1978-43938; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
